source_text: De filiabus Salphaat et de successore Moysis. Quinque filiae Salphaat mortuo patre sine filio interpellant Moysen sortem hereditatis.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning daughters of-Zelophehad and concerning successor of-Moses. Five daughters of-Zelophehad with-dead father without son appeal-to Moses lot of-inheritance.
pass_b_english: On [[Zelophehad’s daughters and Moses’ successor >> Bible:Numbers 27]]: five daughters, their father dead without a son, appeal to Moses for a share of inheritance.
